name: Big-Battle Tanks
summary: Side-scrolling turn-based heavy metal carnage is back! This time with more weapons, larger explosions and earth-shattering SFX! Play solo or against friends on randomly generated destructible battlefields. Choose from a roster of wicked weapons to blast your way to victory in our multiplayer and campaign modes. Air strikes, tactical nukes, spider bombs, forcefields and much, much more are all part of your awesome arsenal. But pick your targets well as environmental factors like wind play a crucial part in this physics-based boom fest!
